title: A Clean Page
hook: Lord, before I reach for my phone this morning, I want to reach for you.
prayer: Thank you for the rest of the night and for the gift of starting again. Whatever was left unfinished yesterday does not get to define me today.
I place my plans, my to-do list and my quiet fears in your hands. You see the whole road, while I only see the next step.
Guide my choices, guard my words, and give me patience with every person I meet today. Let my work be honest and my kindness be real.
I don't want to rush through this day without you. Walk with me through every hour.
description: Start your morning here before anything else. 🌅 Say amen if this is your prayer today.
